page.notes: The first word of the page is partly cut off at the top margin; "consenserit" is a reading I am not certain of. The marginal reference "disp. 52" is partly obscured and uncertain. The page number "182" is read from a worn top-right numeral. The drop-cap "A" of "AD alia" is a large initial; I read it as the start of "Ad alia". The text ends on "non-" with a printed hyphen, continuing on the next page.
